items.headline: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine signs order letting state's 2022 athletes play in 2026-27
items.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine signed an executive order allowing 2022 athletes to play even though the NCAA's new guidance excludes those who have already played four seasons.

items.description: Ohio (4-2) at Sacramento State (1-5), Oct. 17 at 10 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Nick Poulos throws 3 TD passes, helps Ohio beat Central Michigan 31-14 for 16th straight win at home
items.description: — Nick Poulos threw three first-half touchdown passes and Ohio extended the nation's second longest current home winning streak to 16 with a 31-14 victory over Central Michigan on a rainy Saturday.

items.headline: Matt Vezza's TD proves difference in Ohio's 13-10 win over Kent State
items.description: — Matt Vezza had a touchdown run, Will Hryszko made two field goals and Ohio won its Mid-American Conference opener with a 13-10 victory over Kent State on Saturday.
